note: Starting values, not tuned on site footage. Edit this file, then run: python scripts/inference_cfg.py encode

roi.note: Platform-based dynamic ROI (IDSS-derived). Detections whose centroid is outside the Platform rect scaled by the auto_scale factor are dropped before the EWS rules; the Platform itself is always kept. Held for 'hold_frames' frames when the Platform is missing, then no ROI (whole frame). Changes alarm results: re-run the test cases when you change it. Class names are those inside idss_model.onnx (actuator, derrickman, elevators, machine, platform); matching is case-insensitive.

auto_scale.note: No operator zoom flag. 'force' pins the scale: "zoomed" (1.4) or "wide" (1.2) is used for every frame and the size rule is ignored. Set force to null to let the Platform mask decide: width >= zoomed_if_platform_width_fraction_at_least of the frame width means zoomed, else wide. Applies to the ROI scale and the platform overlay scale_x. The 0.30 starting value is NOT tuned: confirm it on site footage before relying on it.

stream.note: Frame rate of the live view and of the frames sent to inference. Frames are dropped, never duplicated. Set lower if inference cannot keep up.

tracking.note: ByteTrack on the PPE boxes (display, detections events, PPE check) and on the IDSS 'derrickman' boxes (person ids for the PPE check only; the EWS facts never see the tracker). The PPE model runs internally down to low_thresh so weak boxes keep a track alive; new tracks still need max(new_track_thresh, the model conf). track_buffer_s: how long a lost box is kept and drawn at its predicted position. Environment RIGMIND_TRACKING=off disables it for A/B tests. Tracking hides flicker; it cannot make the model detect a class it never detects.

ppe_check.note: Each person found by the IDSS model (person_class) is checked for the required PPE. An item counts as present when a PPE box of that class has its centre inside the person box enlarged by person_box_pad. An item missing for missing_seconds raises an Advisory 'PPE not detected: <items>' (the camera may simply not see the item, so the wording is never 'not worn'); it clears after clear_seconds with the item present. No person in view: no check. Class names are matched case-insensitively (vest, safety_vest, hi-vis; glove, gloves; helmet, hardhat).
